title: Easy Beef Stroganoff in the Slow Cooker
description: Beef stroganoff is perfect for the slow cooker; this recipe uses cream of mushroom soup, fresh mushrooms, onions, and herbed cream cheese.
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
6 ounces herb and garlic-flavored cream cheese

steps.text: Combine beef, mushrooms, cream of mushroom soup, milk, onions, and Worcestershire sauce in a slow cooker.
Cook on High for 3 to 4 hours, or on Low for 5 to 7 hours. Stir in cream cheese until well dissolved; cook for 1 hour more.

During the last 20 minutes of cooking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add fusilli to the boiling water and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain.
Serve stroganoff over fusilli and garnish with sour cream.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make an easy and delicious beef stroganoff in the slow cooker. This recipe is made with cream of mushroom soup, cream cheese, garlic, and herbs, and it's the perfect comfort food for a cold day. Simply serve the beef stroganoff over your choice of noodles for a satisfying meal that's sure to impress. Whether you're a busy parent, a college student, or just someone who loves slow cooker meals, this beef stroganoff recipe is sure to become a new favorite.
